tool.name: RRules Parser
tool.description: Retrieve the reaction rules from RetroRules
tool.command: python -m rrparser #if str($rules.type) == "rr02": --rules_file retrorules --release rr02 --rule-type '$rules.rule_type' #elif str($rules.type) == "templates": --rules_file retrorules --release '$rules.release' --dataset '$rules.dataset' --rule-type all #else: --rules_file '$rules.file' --input-format '$rules.input_format' #end if --diameters '$adv.diameters' --output-format csv --rules-dir "\${TMPDIR:-.}" #if str($adv.compress) == "true": --outfile '$out_rules'.csv.gz && mv '$out_rules'.csv.gz '$out_rules' #else: --outfile '$out_rules' #end if #if str($adv.input_conditional_ec.input_type) == "in" --ec '$adv.input_conditional_ec.input_ec_in' #end if #if str($adv.input_conditional_ec.input_type) == "out" --ecx '$adv.input_conditional_ec.input_ec_out' #end if #if $adv.input_scores_file --scores '$adv.input_scores_file' #end if

param.name: type
param.label: Rules source
param.help: RetroRules rr02 (RetroPath2.0 rules), RetroRules 3.x templates, or an input user file

param.name: rule_type
param.label: Rule Type
param.help: Return the rules that are in reverse, forward or both directions

param.name: dataset
param.label: Datasets
param.help: Selecting several datasets aggregates them into one set of templates

param.name: input_scores_file
param.label: Score File
param.help: Filename containing rules names and scores

param.name: input_ec_in
param.label: File containing EC numbers to remove
param.help: EC numbers on one line separated by a comma

param.name: input_ec_out
param.label: File containing EC numbers to remove
param.help: EC numbers on one line separated by a comma

param.label: Select the diameters of the reactions rules
param.help: Diameter of the sphere including the atoms around the reacting center (default is including all values from 0 to 20). The higher is the diameter, the more specific are the rules. RetroRules rr02 only provides diameters 2 to 16

tool.help:
RRulesParser ============
Retrieve the reaction rules from `RetroRules <https://retrorules.org/>`_ extracted from public databases and expressed in the community-standard SMARTS (SMILES arbitrary target specification) format, augmented by a rule representation at different levels of specificity (the atomic environment around the reaction center).
The generated output is a file containing reaction rules which are generic descriptions of chemical reactions that can be used in retrosynthesis workflows (e.g. `Retrosynthesis KNIME Workflow <https://www.myexperiment.org/workflows/4987.html>`_) in order to enumerate all possible biosynthetic routes connecting a target molecule to its precursors.
Input -----
* **Rules source**: (string) one of
* *RetroRules rr02*: the historical rules used by RetroPath2.0 (explicit hydrogens). **Rule Type** returns the rules that are in reverse, forward or both directions. * *RetroRules 3.x templates*: templates with implicit hydrogens from a RetroRules **release** (3.1.0 or 3.0) and one or more **datasets** (MetaNetX, Rhea, USPTO). Selecting several datasets aggregates them: one row is kept per template, with source reactions, EC numbers, radii and datasets merged and the highest score retained. Templates carry no retro/forward annotation, so all rules are returned. * *Other reaction rules*: a user file of reaction rules.
* **rules-file**: (string) Filename of reaction rules provided in csv or tsv format. * **input_format**: (string) input file format (csv: default, tsv) * **diameters**: (integer list) diameter of the sphere including the atoms around the reacting center (default is including all even values from 0 to 20). The higher is the diameter, the more specific are the rules. RetroRules rr02 only provides diameters 2 to 16; for templates, diameter = 2 * radius * **EC numbers to filter**: retain or remove some EC numbers. A file is expected containing EC numbers separated by a comma on the first line. * **Scores file**: file containing rules names and scores
Ouput -----
* **out_rules**: (string): file containing the parsed reactions rules (default=csv). It will be zipped if *Compress output* is set to yes. For RetroRules 3.x templates, the columns are *Rule ID*, *Rule*, *EC number*, *Score*, *REACTIONS*, *RADII*, *RADIUS_MIN*, *RADIUS_MAX* and *DATASETS*; the RADII column only keeps the selected radii.
